profile_text.body:
Intel Corp is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, trading under the ticker INTC, with SEC filings recorded under CIK 0000050863. Its website is intel.com. On that site the company describes itself as delivering AI at scale across cloud, data center, edge, and client through what it calls comprehensive hardware and software solutions, and it notes that Fortune has recognized its work in AI, computing, and semiconductor manufacturing.

The site material centers on that AI positioning rather than on named products. No specific Intel products are tracked in the record, and no MCP servers are listed.

The record also shows 281 litigation entries for the company in California. No individual cases are named in the material available.
